summary: Add Query().field.between(low, high) method for inclusive range queries that composes with &, |, ~, works with query cache, treats missing fields as non-matching, and accepts any orderable type with empty result when low > high.

acceptance_criteria.then: returns [] (empty list, no match when low > high)

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with documents {'ts': datetime(2024,1,1)}, {'ts': datetime(2024,6,1)}, {'ts': datetime(2024,12,31)}
a TinyDB instance with documents {'age': 25}, {'name': 'Bob'} (missing age)
acceptance_criteria.then: returns [{'age': 25}] (document without 'age' field does not match)

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with documents {'age': 25, 'active': True}, {'age': 30, 'active': False}, {'age': 35, 'active': True}
a TinyDB instance with CachingMiddleware enabled and documents {'age': 25}, {'age': 30}
acceptance_criteria.then: second call returns cached result (same list object or equal content) without re-scanning storage

acceptance_criteria.given: the test suite for the new between method
acceptance_criteria.then: coverage for the between method and its query class is 100%

assumptions.assumption: between accepts any orderable type (numbers, strings, datetimes, etc.)
assumptions.default_used: Any orderable type, matching existing comparison operators

assumptions.assumption: When low > high, the query matches no documents (empty result)
assumptions.default_used: Empty result, consistent with (field >= low) & (field <= high) and SQL BETWEEN

assumptions.assumption: Both bounds are inclusive (low <= v <= high)
